title: Postdoctoral Fellow - Craig Brown & Sue Smith Endowed Postdoctoral Fellowship in Cancer Immunology

cond_0001.intro: The [Company name masked] Endowed Postdoctoral Fellowship in Cancer Immunology supports research training in cancer immunology and immunotherapy. The fellowship focuses on developing innovative preventive vaccines and therapeutic platforms that use the immune system to fight cancer, as well as cell engineering, local cell recruitment, and reprogramming. Research will be conducted in Grattoni's Laboratory at [Company name masked] in [Location masked].
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Research Focus:
The fellowship will revolve around the development of innovative strategies to elicit potent anti-cancer responses from the immune system. This involves investigating and creating preventive vaccines and therapeutic platforms, pushing the boundaries of our understanding of immunology and cell engineering. The research may include exploring local cell recruitment and reprogramming techniques that hold promise in the fight against cancer.
Application Process:
Applicants are encouraged to submit their CV, a cover letter outlining their research interests, contact information for 3 references, and a list of their first-author publications. The selection process will be highly competitive, and candidates with a demonstrated interest in advancing cancer immunology, the qualifications mentioned above, and a strong publication record will be given preference.
People Essential Functions:
Assists the physician in maintaining the functionality and operations of the Principal Investigator's (PI) laboratory.
Promotes a positive work environment and leads the team to be dynamic and a focused work unit that actively helps one another to achieve optimal department results.
Collaborates with all members of the department by actively communicating and reporting data in a comprehensive manner.
Role models to team members effective verbal, non-verbal and written communication, which includes active listening and teaching, assisting in development of such skills.
Provides contributions towards improvement of department scores for employee engagement, i.e. Peer-to-peer accountability.
Service Essential Functions:
Develops research methods and performs research activities.
Documents research results and writes reports of results for presentation and/or publication in professional journals and other publications.
Quality/Safety Essential Functions:
Follows all safety rules while on the job. Reports accidents promptly and corrects minor safety hazards. Communicates with peers and management regarding any hazards identified in the workplace.
Assists with implementation and education of department-based safety initiatives, standards of practice and protocols. Develops skills of team members and continually assists with improving skills, performance and outcomes.
Identifies opportunities for corrective action and process improvement providing recommendations and contributes to meeting department and laboratory targets for quality and safety.
Finance Essential Functions:
Utilizes resources effectively and efficiently, demonstrating responsible financial stewardship. Manages own time effectively and prioritizes work to achieve maximum results in a timely manner.
Uses resources efficiently; does not waste supplies. Self-motivated to independently manage time effectively and prioritize daily tasks.
Growth/Innovation Essential Functions:
Participates in pertinent research activities and evidenced-based practice projects. Participates in departmental projects and activities. Acts as a change agent.
Seeks opportunities to expand learning beyond baseline competencies with a focus on continual development. Remains current on professional issues and clinical skills. Completes and updates the My Development Plan on an on-going basis. Ensures own career discussions occur with appropriate management.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
Ph.D. Or M.D. Ph.D. In cancer immunology or a related field, awarded within the last 2 years (a letter from the academic institution certifying that all student work is complete will be considered for Postdoctoral Fellow 0 only)
Solid record of first-author publications in peer-reviewed journals
Proficiency in immunotherapeutics, in vivo preclinical tumor models, rodent handling, and flow cytometry
Strong experience in relevant laboratory techniques and methodologies
Excellent writing and communication skills
Preferred Requirements:
High levels of initiative, proactiveness, and a commitment to achieving scientific excellence
Postdoctoral Fellow 0: no postdoc experience required
Postdoctoral Fellow 1: one year of postdoc experience
Postdoctoral Fellow 2: two years of postdoc experience
Postdoctoral Fellow 3: three years of postdoc experience
Postdoctoral Fellow 4: four years of postdoc experience

cond_0036.intro: The Smith and Brown Endowed Postdoctoral Fellowship in Cancer Immunology is an opportunity for individuals who have recently graduated with a Ph.D. Or M.D. Ph.D. Degree in cancer immunobiology or a related field (within a maximum of 2 years after obtaining their degree). This fellowship is dedicated to the advancement of cancer immunology and immunotherapy, with a focus on developing innovative preventive vaccines and therapeutic devices and platforms that harness the body's immune system to combat cancer. The fellow will also have the opportunity to work at the forefront of cell engineering and explore local cell recruitment and reprogramming. This fellowship supports individuals to conduct research training in the Grattoni's Laboratory at [Company name masked], in [Location masked].
cond_0036.responsibilities:
Research Focus:
The fellowship will revolve around coordinating on the development of innovative strategies to elicit potent anti-cancer responses from the immune system. This involves working alongside the team to investigate and create preventive vaccines and therapeutic platforms, contributing to our shared understanding of immunology and cell engineering. The research may include collaborating on local cell recruitment and reprogramming techniques that hold promise in the fight against cancer.
Application Process:
Applicants interested in the Smith and Brown Endowed Postdoctoral Fellowship in Cancer Immunology are encouraged to submit their application materials, including their CV, a cover letter outlining their research interests, contact information for 3 references, and a list of their first-author publications. The selection process will be competitive, and candidates with a demonstrated interest in advancing cancer immunology, the qualifications mentioned above, and a strong publication record will be given preference.
People Essential Functions:
Assists the physician in maintaining the functionality and operations of the Principal Investigator's (PI) laboratory.
Supports a positive work environment and works with the team to stay focused and help one another achieve optimal department results.
Collaborates with all members of the department by actively communicating and reporting data in a comprehensive manner.
Shares effective verbal, non-verbal and written communication practices with team members, including active listening and teaching, and assists in developing such skills.
Contributes towards improvement of department scores for employee engagement, i.e. Peer-to-peer accountability.
Service Essential Functions:
Develops research methods and performs research activities.
Documents research results and writes reports of results for presentation and/or publication in professional journals and other publications.
Quality/Safety Essential Functions:
Follows all safety rules while on the job. Reports accidents promptly and corrects minor safety hazards. Communicates with peers and management regarding any hazards identified in the workplace.
Assists with implementation and education of department-based safety initiatives, standards of practice and protocols. Supports the development of team members' skills and continually helps with improving skills, performance and outcomes.
Identifies opportunities for corrective action and process improvement, shares recommendations, and contributes to meeting department and laboratory targets for quality and safety.
Finance Essential Functions:
Utilizes resources effectively and efficiently, demonstrating responsible financial stewardship. Manages own time effectively and prioritizes work to achieve maximum results in a timely manner.
Uses resources efficiently; does not waste supplies. Manages time effectively and prioritizes daily tasks.
Growth/Innovation Essential Functions:
Participates in pertinent research activities and evidenced-based practice projects. Participates in departmental projects and activities. Contributes as a change agent.
Seeks opportunities to expand learning beyond baseline competencies with a focus on continual development. Remains current on professional issues and clinical skills. Completes and updates the My Development Plan on an on-going basis. Ensures own career discussions occur with appropriate management.
This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive; the employee will also perform other reasonably related business/job duties as assigned. [Company name masked] reserves the right to revise job duties and responsibilities as the need arises.

A Ph.D. Or M.D. Ph.D. Degree in cancer immunology or a related field (awarded within the last 2 years).
A solid record of publications as first authors in peer-reviewed journals.
Proficiency in immunotherapeutics, in vivo preclinical tumor models, rodent handling, and flow cytometry.
Strong experience in relevant laboratory techniques and methodologies.
Excellent writing and communication skills.
High levels of initiative, proactiveness, and a commitment to achieving scientific excellence.
Doctor of Medicine (MD) from an accredited medical school or Doctoral Degree (PhD) in medical field (A letter from the academic institution certifying that all student work is complete will be considered for Postdoctoral Fellow 0 only.)

cond_0236.intro: The Endowed Postdoctoral Fellowship in Cancer Immunology is an opportunity for recent graduates with a Ph.D. Or M.D./Ph.D. In cancer immunobiology or a related field. The fellowship is dedicated to advancing cancer immunology and immunotherapy, with a focus on developing innovative preventive vaccines and therapeutic platforms that harness the immune system to combat cancer. The successful candidate will work at the forefront of cell engineering and explore local cell recruitment and reprogramming. Research training will be conducted in the Grattoni Laboratory at [Company name masked], located in [Location masked].
cond_0236.responsibilities:
Research Focus:
The fellowship will revolve around the development of innovative strategies to elicit potent anti-cancer responses from the immune system. This involves investigating and creating preventive vaccines and therapeutic platforms, pushing the boundaries of our understanding of immunology and cell engineering. The research may include exploring local cell recruitment and reprogramming techniques that hold promise in the fight against cancer.
People Essential Functions:
Assists the physician in maintaining the functionality and operations of the Principal Investigator's (PI) laboratory.
Promotes a positive work environment and leads the team to be dynamic and a focused work unit that actively helps one another to achieve optimal department results.
Collaborates with all members of the department by actively communicating and reporting data in a comprehensive manner.
Role models to team members effective verbal, non-verbal and written communication, which includes active listening and teaching, assisting in development of such skills.
Provides contributions towards improvement of department scores for employee engagement, i.e. Peer-to-peer accountability.
Service Essential Functions:
Develops research methods and performs research activities.
Documents research results and writes reports of results for presentation and/or publication in professional journals and other publications.
Quality/Safety Essential Functions:
Follows all safety rules while on the job. Reports accidents promptly and corrects minor safety hazards. Communicates with peers and management regarding any hazards identified in the workplace.
Assists with implementation and education of department-based safety initiatives, standards of practice and protocols. Develops skills of team members and continually assists with improving skills, performance and outcomes.
Identifies opportunities for corrective action and process improvement providing recommendations and contributes to meeting department and laboratory targets for quality and safety.
Finance Essential Functions:
Utilizes resources effectively and efficiently, demonstrating responsible financial stewardship. Manages own time effectively and prioritizes work to achieve maximum results in a timely manner.
Uses resources efficiently; does not waste supplies. Self-motivated to independently manage time effectively and prioritize daily tasks.
Growth/Innovation Essential Functions:
Participates in pertinent research activities and evidenced-based practice projects. Participates in departmental projects and activities. Acts as a change agent.
Seeks opportunities to expand learning beyond baseline competencies with a focus on continual development. Remains current on professional issues and clinical skills. Completes and updates the My Development Plan on an on-going basis. Ensures own career discussions occur with appropriate management.
Application Process:
Applicants are encouraged to submit their CV, a cover letter outlining their research interests, contact information for 3 references, and a list of their first-author publications.
cond_0236.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
Ph.D. Or M.D./Ph.D. In cancer immunology or a related field, awarded within the last 2 years (a letter from the academic institution certifying that all student work is complete will be considered for Postdoctoral Fellow 0 only)
Demonstrated expertise in immunotherapeutics, in vivo preclinical tumor models, rodent handling, and flow cytometry
Strong command of relevant laboratory techniques and methodologies
Exceptional writing and communication skills
Postdoctoral experience requirements by level: Postdoctoral Fellow 0 — none; Postdoctoral Fellow 1 — minimum 1 year of postdoc experience; Postdoctoral Fellow 2 — minimum 2 years of postdoc experience; Postdoctoral Fellow 3 — minimum 3 years of postdoc experience; Postdoctoral Fellow 4 — minimum 4 years of postdoc experience
Preferred Requirements:
Substantial first-author publication record in peer-reviewed journals
Proven track record of initiative, proactiveness, and commitment to achieving scientific excellence

cond_0271.intro: The [Company name masked] Endowed Postdoctoral Fellowship in Cancer Immunology supports research training in cancer immunology and immunotherapy. The fellowship focuses on developing innovative preventive vaccines and therapeutic platforms that use the immune system to fight cancer, as well as cell engineering, local cell recruitment, and reprogramming. Research will be conducted in Grattoni's Laboratory at [Company name masked] in [Location masked].
cond_0271.responsibilities:
Research Focus:
The fellowship will revolve around the development of innovative strategies to elicit potent anti-cancer responses from the immune system. This involves investigating and creating preventive vaccines and therapeutic platforms, pushing the boundaries of our understanding of immunology and cell engineering. The research may include exploring local cell recruitment and reprogramming techniques that hold promise in the fight against cancer.
Application Process:
Applicants are encouraged to submit their CV, a cover letter outlining their research interests, contact information for 3 references, and a list of their first-author publications. The selection process will be highly competitive, and candidates with a demonstrated interest in advancing cancer immunology, the qualifications mentioned above, and a strong publication record will be given preference.
People Essential Functions:
Assists the physician in maintaining the functionality and operations of the Principal Investigator's (PI) laboratory.
Promotes a positive work environment and leads the team to be dynamic and a focused work unit that actively helps one another to achieve optimal department results.
Collaborates with all members of the department by actively communicating and reporting data in a comprehensive manner.
Role models to team members effective verbal, non-verbal and written communication, which includes active listening and teaching, assisting in development of such skills.
Provides contributions towards improvement of department scores for employee engagement, i.e. Peer-to-peer accountability.
Service Essential Functions:
Develops research methods and performs research activities.
Documents research results and writes reports of results for presentation and/or publication in professional journals and other publications.
Quality/Safety Essential Functions:
Follows all safety rules while on the job. Reports accidents promptly and corrects minor safety hazards. Communicates with peers and management regarding any hazards identified in the workplace.
Assists with implementation and education of department-based safety initiatives, standards of practice and protocols. Develops skills of team members and continually assists with improving skills, performance and outcomes.
Identifies opportunities for corrective action and process improvement providing recommendations and contributes to meeting department and laboratory targets for quality and safety.
Finance Essential Functions:
Utilizes resources effectively and efficiently, demonstrating responsible financial stewardship. Manages own time effectively and prioritizes work to achieve maximum results in a timely manner.
Uses resources efficiently; does not waste supplies. Self-motivated to independently manage time effectively and prioritize daily tasks.
Growth/Innovation Essential Functions:
Participates in pertinent research activities and evidenced-based practice projects. Participates in departmental projects and activities. Acts as a change agent.
Seeks opportunities to expand learning beyond baseline competencies with a focus on continual development. Remains current on professional issues and clinical skills. Completes and updates the My Development Plan on an on-going basis. Ensures own career discussions occur with appropriate management.
cond_0271.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
Ph.D. Or M.D. Ph.D. In cancer immunology or a related field, awarded within the last 2 years (a letter from the academic institution certifying that all student work is complete will be considered for Postdoctoral Fellow 0 only)
Solid record of first-author publications in peer-reviewed journals
Proficiency in immunotherapeutics, in vivo preclinical tumor models, rodent handling, and flow cytometry
Strong experience in relevant laboratory techniques and methodologies
Excellent writing and communication skills
Preferred Requirements:
High levels of initiative, proactiveness, and a commitment to achieving scientific excellence
Postdoctoral Fellow 0: no postdoc experience required
Postdoctoral Fellow 1: one year of postdoc experience
Postdoctoral Fellow 2: two years of postdoc experience
Postdoctoral Fellow 3: three years of postdoc experience
Postdoctoral Fellow 4: four years of postdoc experience

cond_0278.intro: The Smith and Brown Endowed Postdoctoral Fellowship in Cancer Immunology is an opportunity for individuals who have recently completed a Ph.D. Or M.D./Ph.D. In cancer immunobiology or a related field. This fellowship is dedicated to advancing cancer immunology and immunotherapy, with a focus on developing innovative preventive vaccines and therapeutic devices and platforms that harness the immune system to combat cancer. The fellow will also work at the forefront of cell engineering and explore local cell recruitment and reprogramming. Research training will be conducted in the Grattoni Laboratory at [Company name masked], [Location masked].
cond_0278.responsibilities:
Research Focus:
The fellowship centers on developing innovative strategies to elicit potent anti-cancer immune responses. The fellow will lead the investigation and creation of preventive vaccines and therapeutic platforms, driving forward our understanding of immunology and cell engineering. Research will include executing studies on local cell recruitment and reprogramming techniques with potential applications in cancer treatment.
People Essential Functions:
Take ownership of maintaining the functionality and operations of the Principal Investigator's laboratory.
Direct team efforts to build a focused, dynamic work unit where members actively support one another to achieve strong department results.
Lead communication across all department members, ensuring data is reported clearly and comprehensively.
Model effective verbal, non-verbal, and written communication for team members, including active listening and teaching.
Contribute to improving department employee engagement scores through peer-to-peer accountability.
Service Essential Functions:
Develop research methods and execute research activities.
Document research results and produce reports for presentation and publication in professional journals.
Quality/Safety Essential Functions:
Follow all safety rules on the job. Report accidents promptly and resolve minor safety hazards.
Communicate with peers and management about any workplace hazards identified.
Lead implementation and education of department safety initiatives, standards of practice, and protocols.
Develop team members' skills and drive continuous improvement in performance and outcomes.
Identify opportunities for corrective action and process improvement, providing recommendations and contributing to department and laboratory quality and safety targets.
Finance Essential Functions:
Use resources effectively and efficiently, demonstrating responsible financial stewardship.
Manage time independently and prioritize work to deliver results in a timely manner.
Avoid waste of supplies and take ownership of daily task prioritization.
Growth/Innovation Essential Functions:
Lead participation in relevant research activities and evidence-based practice projects.
Take initiative in departmental projects and activities. Act as a change agent.
Seek opportunities to expand competencies with a focus on continual development.
Stay current on professional issues and clinical skills. Maintain and update a development plan on an ongoing basis and ensure career discussions occur with appropriate management.
This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive; the employee will also perform other reasonably related business/job duties as assigned. [Company name masked] reserves the right to revise job duties and responsibilities as the need arises.
cond_0278.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
Ph.D. Or M.D./Ph.D. In cancer immunology or a related field, awarded within the last 2 years (a letter from the academic institution certifying that all student work is complete will be considered for Postdoctoral Fellow 0 only)
Proficiency in immunotherapeutics, in vivo preclinical tumor models, rodent handling, and flow cytometry
Strong experience in relevant laboratory techniques and methodologies
Excellent writing and communication skills
Postdoctoral Fellow 0: no postdoc experience required; Postdoctoral Fellow 1: one year of postdoc experience; Postdoctoral Fellow 2: two years of postdoc experience; Postdoctoral Fellow 3: three years of postdoc experience; Postdoctoral Fellow 4: four years of postdoc experience
Preferred Requirements:
A solid record of first-author publications in peer-reviewed journals
High levels of initiative, proactiveness, and a commitment to scientific excellence
Application materials should include a CV, a cover letter outlining research interests, contact information for three references, and a list of first-author publications. Candidates with a strong publication record and demonstrated interest in advancing cancer immunology will be given preference.

Documents research results and writes reports for presentation and/or publication in professional journals and other publications.

Identifies opportunities for corrective action and process improvement, provides recommendations, and contributes to meeting department and laboratory targets for quality and safety.

Participates in relevant research activities and evidence-based practice projects. Participates in departmental projects and activities. Acts as a change agent.
Seeks opportunities to expand learning beyond baseline competencies with a focus on ongoing development. Stays current on professional issues and clinical skills. Completes and updates the My Development Plan on an ongoing basis. Ensures career discussions take place with appropriate management.

A Ph.D. Or M.D. Ph.D. In cancer immunology or a related field, awarded within the last 2 years.

Assists the physician in maintaining the functionality and operations of the Principal Investigator's (PI) laboratory.
Promotes a positive work environment and leads the team to be dynamic and a focused work unit that actively helps one other to achieve optimal department results.
Collaborates with all members of the department by actively communicating and reporting data in a comprehensive manner.
Role models to team members effective verbal, non-verbal and written communication, which includes active listening and teaching, assisting in development of such skills.
Provides contributions towards improvement of department scores for employee engagement, i.e. Peer-to-peer accountability.
Service Essential Functions
Develops research methods and performs research activities.
Documents research results and writes reports of results for presentation and/or publication in professional journals and other publications.
Quality/Safety Essential Functions
Follows all safety rules while on the job. Reports accidents promptly and corrects minor safety hazards. Communicates with peers and management regarding any hazards identified in the workplace.
Assists with implementation and education of department-based safety initiatives, standards of practice and protocols. Develops skills of team members and continually assists with improving skills, performance and outcomes.
Identifies opportunities for corrective action and process improvement providing recommendations and contributes to meeting department and laboratory targets for quality and safety.
Finance Essential Functions
Utilizes resources effectively and efficiently, demonstrating responsible financial stewardship. Manages own time effectively and prioritizes work to achieve maximum results in a timely manner.
Uses resources efficiently; does not waste supplies. Self-motivated to independently manage time effectively and prioritize daily tasks.
Growth/Innovation Essential Functions
Participates in pertinent research activities and evidenced-based practice projects. Participates in departmental projects and activities. Acts as a change agent.
Seeks opportunities to expand learning beyond baseline competencies with a focus on continual development. Remains current on professional issues and clinical skills. Completes and updates the My Development Plan on an on-going basis. Ensures own career discussions occur with appropriate management.
Research Focus
The fellowship will revolve around the development of innovative strategies to elicit potent anti-cancer responses from the immune system. This involves investigating and creating preventive vaccines and therapeutic platforms, pushing the boundaries of our understanding of immunology and cell engineering. The research may include exploring local cell recruitment and reprogramming techniques that hold promise in the fight against cancer.
Application Process
Applicants interested in the Smith and Brown Endowed Postdoctoral Fellowship in Cancer Immunology are encouraged to submit their application materials, including their CV, a cover letter outlining their research interests, contact information for 3 references, and a list of their first-author publications. The selection process will be highly competitive, and candidates with a demonstrated passion for advancing cancer immunology, the qualifications mentioned above, and a strong publication record will be given preference.
Contacts
Email: Grattonilab@houstonmethodist.org
Webpage: https://grattoni.hmailabs.org/
cond_0300.requirements:
A Ph.D. Or M.D. Ph.D. Degree in cancer immunology or a related field, or equivalent practical experience (awarded within the last 2 years; a letter from the academic institution certifying that all student work is complete will be considered for Postdoctoral Fellow 0 only).
A record of publications as first author in peer-reviewed journals.
Working knowledge of immunotherapeutics, in vivo preclinical tumor models, rodent handling, and flow cytometry.
Background in relevant laboratory techniques and methodologies.
Ability to communicate effectively in writing and verbally.
Willingness to take initiative and openness to feedback, with a commitment to contributing to scientific work.

cond_0331.intro: The Smith and Brown Endowed Postdoctoral Fellowship in Cancer Immunology is an opportunity for individuals who have recently completed a Ph.D. Or M.D./Ph.D. In cancer immunobiology or a related field (within 2 years of degree completion). The fellowship focuses on advancing cancer immunology and immunotherapy, with emphasis on developing preventive vaccines and therapeutic platforms that engage the immune system to target cancer. The fellow will also work in cell engineering, including local cell recruitment and reprogramming. Research training will be conducted in Grattoni's Laboratory at [Company name masked], located in [Location masked].
cond_0331.responsibilities:
Research Focus:
The fellowship centers on developing strategies to elicit anti-cancer immune responses. Work includes investigating and building preventive vaccines and therapeutic platforms, and may involve local cell recruitment and reprogramming techniques.
People Essential Functions:
Supports the Principal Investigator (PI) in maintaining laboratory functionality and operations.
Contributes to a focused work unit by helping team members meet department objectives.
Coordinates with department members by reporting data clearly and accurately.
Demonstrates effective written and verbal communication, including active listening; supports development of these skills in others.
Contributes to department employee engagement metrics through peer accountability.
Service Essential Functions:
Develops research methods and carries out research activities.
Documents results and prepares reports for publication or presentation in professional journals.
Quality/Safety Essential Functions:
Follows all safety rules; reports accidents promptly and addresses minor safety hazards.
Communicates identified workplace hazards to peers and management.
Supports implementation and education of department safety initiatives, standards of practice, and protocols.
Helps develop team members' skills and supports improvement in performance and outcomes.
Identifies opportunities for corrective action and process improvement; contributes to meeting department quality and safety targets.
Finance Essential Functions:
Uses resources effectively and efficiently, demonstrating responsible financial stewardship.
Manages own time and prioritizes tasks to achieve results in a timely manner.
Avoids unnecessary use of supplies.
Growth/Innovation Essential Functions:
Participates in relevant research activities and evidence-based practice projects.
Takes part in departmental projects and activities.
Seeks opportunities to expand competencies through focused professional development.
Stays current on professional issues and clinical skills.
Maintains a development plan and ensures career discussions occur with appropriate management.
This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive; the employee will also perform other reasonably related business/job duties as assigned. [Company name masked] reserves the right to revise job duties and responsibilities as the need arises.
cond_0331.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
Ph.D. Or M.D./Ph.D. In cancer immunology or a related field, awarded within the last 2 years.
Solid record of first-author publications in peer-reviewed journals.
Proficiency in immunotherapeutics, in vivo preclinical tumor models, rodent handling, and flow cytometry.
Strong experience in relevant laboratory techniques and methodologies.
Doctor of Medicine (MD) from an accredited medical school or Doctoral Degree (PhD) in a medical field. (A letter from the academic institution certifying that all student work is complete will be considered for Postdoctoral Fellow 0 only.)
Preferred Requirements:
Strong written communication and clear, direct verbal reporting skills.
Demonstrated initiative and commitment to scientific rigor.
Postdoctoral experience appropriate to fellowship level:
Postdoctoral Fellow 0: None
Postdoctoral Fellow 1: One year of postdoc experience
Postdoctoral Fellow 2: Two years of postdoc experience
Postdoctoral Fellow 3: Three years of postdoc experience
Postdoctoral Fellow 4: Four years of postdoc experience

The fellowship is focused on cancer immunology and immunotherapy, with an emphasis on developing preventive vaccines and therapeutic devices and platforms that use the immune system to target cancer. The fellow will also engage with cell engineering work, including local cell recruitment and reprogramming. Research training will be conducted in the Grattoni Laboratory at [Company name masked], located in [Location masked].
cond_0430.responsibilities:
Develops research methods and carries out research activities in cancer immunology and immunotherapy.
Investigates and develops preventive vaccines and therapeutic platforms aimed at eliciting anti-cancer immune responses.
Explores local cell recruitment and reprogramming techniques relevant to cancer treatment.
Documents research results and writes reports for submission to peer-reviewed journals and other publications.
Supports the functionality and operations of the Principal Investigator's laboratory.
Follows all safety protocols. Reports accidents and addresses minor safety hazards. Flags any workplace hazards to relevant personnel.
Contributes to department safety initiatives, standards of practice, and protocols.
Identifies opportunities for corrective action and process improvement, and contributes to meeting department and laboratory quality and safety targets.
Uses resources efficiently and manages time to complete tasks effectively.
Participates in relevant research activities and evidence-based practice projects.
Keeps current on professional and clinical developments. Maintains own development plan and holds career discussions with appropriate management.
cond_0430.requirements:
Ph.D. Or M.D. Ph.D. In cancer immunology or a related field, awarded within the last 2 years.
MD from an accredited medical school or doctoral degree in a medical field (a letter from the academic institution certifying completion of all student work will be considered for Postdoctoral Fellow 0 only).
Solid record of first-author publications in peer-reviewed journals.
Proficiency in immunotherapeutics, in vivo preclinical tumor models, rodent handling, and flow cytometry.
Strong experience in relevant laboratory techniques and methodologies.
Strong written communication and clear, direct verbal reporting skills.
Postdoctoral Fellow 0 - No postdoc experience required.

cond_0459.intro: The Smith and Brown Endowed Postdoctoral Fellowship in Cancer Immunology supports recent graduates to conduct research training in the Grattoni's Laboratory at [Company name masked], in [Location masked]. The fellowship is dedicated to advancing cancer immunology and immunotherapy, with a focus on developing innovative preventive vaccines and therapeutic devices and platforms that work with the body's immune system to combat cancer. Fellows will also have the opportunity to work alongside colleagues at the forefront of cell engineering and explore local cell recruitment and reprogramming.
cond_0459.responsibilities:
Research Focus:
The fellowship centers on collaborative development of innovative strategies to elicit potent anti-cancer responses from the immune system. This involves working with the team to investigate and build preventive vaccines and therapeutic platforms, contributing to shared understanding of immunology and cell engineering. The research may include coordinating on local cell recruitment and reprogramming techniques that hold promise in the fight against cancer.
People Essential Functions:
Support the physician in maintaining the functionality and operations of the Principal Investigator's (PI) laboratory.
Help foster a positive work environment and work with the team to achieve optimal department results.
Collaborate with all members of the department by actively communicating and sharing data in a comprehensive manner.
Model effective verbal, non-verbal and written communication for team members, including active listening and teaching, and assist in developing such skills.
Contribute to improvement of department scores for employee engagement, including peer-to-peer accountability.
Service Essential Functions:
Coordinate on research methods and carry out research activities together with the team.
Document research results and write reports for presentation and/or publication in professional journals and other publications.
Quality/Safety Essential Functions:
Follow all safety rules while on the job. Report accidents promptly and correct minor safety hazards. Share information with peers and management regarding any hazards identified in the workplace.
Assist with implementation and education of department-based safety initiatives, standards of practice and protocols. Help develop team members' skills and continually support improvement in skills, performance and outcomes.
Identify opportunities for corrective action and process improvement, provide recommendations, and contribute to meeting department and laboratory targets for quality and safety.
Finance Essential Functions:
Use resources effectively and efficiently, demonstrating responsible financial stewardship. Manage own time effectively and coordinate priorities to achieve results in a timely manner.
Use resources efficiently; does not waste supplies. Manage time effectively and prioritize daily tasks.
Growth/Innovation Essential Functions:
Participate in pertinent research activities and evidence-based practice projects. Contribute to departmental projects and activities.
Seek opportunities to expand learning beyond baseline competencies with a focus on continual development. Remain current on professional issues and clinical skills. Complete and update the My Development Plan on an ongoing basis. Ensure own career discussions occur with appropriate management.
This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive; the employee will also perform other reasonably related business/job duties as assigned. [Company name masked] reserves the right to revise job duties and responsibilities as the need arises.
cond_0459.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
Ph.D. Or M.D. Ph.D. Degree in cancer immunology or a related field (awarded within the last 2 years)
Doctor of Medicine (MD) from an accredited medical school or Doctoral Degree (PhD) in a medical field (a letter from the academic institution certifying that all student work is complete will be considered for Postdoctoral Fellow 0 only)
Solid record of publications as first author in peer-reviewed journals
Proficiency in immunotherapeutics, in vivo preclinical tumor models, rodent handling, and flow cytometry
Strong experience in relevant laboratory techniques and methodologies
Excellent writing and communication skills
Preferred Requirements:
High levels of initiative, proactiveness, and a commitment to achieving scientific excellence
Postdoctoral Fellow 0: None
Postdoctoral Fellow 1: One year of postdoc experience
Postdoctoral Fellow 2: Two years of postdoc experience
Postdoctoral Fellow 3: Three years of postdoc experience
Postdoctoral Fellow 4: Four years of postdoc experience
Applicants interested in the fellowship are encouraged to submit their CV, a cover letter outlining their research interests, contact information for 3 references, and a list of their first-author publications. The selection process will be competitive, and candidates with a demonstrated interest in advancing cancer immunology, the qualifications listed above, and a strong publication record will be given preference.

The successful candidate will work at the forefront of cell engineering and explore local cell recruitment and reprogramming. Research training will be conducted in the Grattoni Laboratory at [Company name masked], located in [Location masked].
cond_0488.responsibilities:
Research Focus:
The fellowship will revolve around the development of innovative strategies to elicit potent anti-cancer responses from the immune system. This involves investigating and creating preventive vaccines and therapeutic platforms, pushing the boundaries of our understanding of immunology and cell engineering. The research may include exploring local cell recruitment and reprogramming techniques that hold promise in the fight against cancer.
People Essential Functions:
Assists the physician in maintaining the functionality and operations of the Principal Investigator's (PI) laboratory.
Promotes a positive work environment and leads the team to be dynamic and a focused work unit that actively helps one another to achieve optimal department results.
Collaborates with all members of the department by actively communicating and reporting data in a comprehensive manner.
Role models to team members effective verbal, non-verbal and written communication, which includes active listening and teaching, assisting in development of such skills.
Provides contributions towards improvement of department scores for employee engagement, i.e. Peer-to-peer accountability.
Service Essential Functions:
Develops research methods and performs research activities.
Documents research results and writes reports of results for presentation and/or publication in professional journals and other publications.
Quality/Safety Essential Functions:
Follows all safety rules while on the job. Reports accidents promptly and corrects minor safety hazards. Communicates with peers and management regarding any hazards identified in the workplace.
Assists with implementation and education of department-based safety initiatives, standards of practice and protocols. Develops skills of team members and continually assists with improving skills, performance and outcomes.
Identifies opportunities for corrective action and process improvement providing recommendations and contributes to meeting department and laboratory targets for quality and safety.
Finance Essential Functions:
Utilizes resources effectively and efficiently, demonstrating responsible financial stewardship. Manages own time effectively and prioritizes work to achieve maximum results in a timely manner.
Uses resources efficiently; does not waste supplies. Self-motivated to independently manage time effectively and prioritize daily tasks.
Growth/Innovation Essential Functions:
Participates in pertinent research activities and evidenced-based practice projects. Participates in departmental projects and activities. Acts as a change agent.
Seeks opportunities to expand learning beyond baseline competencies with a focus on continual development. Remains current on professional issues and clinical skills. Completes and updates the My Development Plan on an on-going basis. Ensures own career discussions occur with appropriate management.
Application Process:
Applicants are encouraged to submit their CV, a cover letter outlining their research interests, contact information for 3 references, and a list of their first-author publications.
cond_0488.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
Ph.D. Or M.D./Ph.D. In cancer immunology or a related field, awarded within the last 2 years (a letter from the academic institution certifying that all student work is complete will be considered for Postdoctoral Fellow 0 only)
Demonstrated expertise in immunotherapeutics, in vivo preclinical tumor models, rodent handling, and flow cytometry
Strong command of relevant laboratory techniques and methodologies
Exceptional writing and communication skills
Postdoctoral experience requirements by level: Postdoctoral Fellow 0 — none; Postdoctoral Fellow 1 — minimum 1 year of postdoc experience; Postdoctoral Fellow 2 — minimum 2 years of postdoc experience; Postdoctoral Fellow 3 — minimum 3 years of postdoc experience; Postdoctoral Fellow 4 — minimum 4 years of postdoc experience
Preferred Requirements:
Substantial first-author publication record in peer-reviewed journals
Proven track record of initiative, proactiveness, and commitment to achieving scientific excellence
